name: Terrance Grant
strengths: Grant presses the hole on one cut out of shotgun/pistol offset and is already north-south — he does not dance in the backfield on this DeMatha reel.
Grant finishes through contact: pads down on short-yardage plunges and keeps his legs churning through arm tackles at the second level.
Grant's stiff-arm and compact 5-11 / 220 frame show up when a DB is the last man — he runs through the tackle rather than trying to make him miss.
weaknesses: Grant is a linear power back on this tape, not a phone-booth slasher. Pass protection and a downfield route tree are not on the DeMatha 1-8 sit — do not write him up as a finished three-down back from highlight TDs.
comparison: Grant comps to Isiah Pacheco — 5-10 / 216 compact one-cut runner who finishes through contact, not a long-strider slasher (size-matched to Grant's 5-11 / 220; not a Florida-alum default).
projection: Grant projects as Year 1 develop in Foster's room, Year 2 compete in the running back committee, with starter-upside as a compact early-down finisher — not a rotational afterthought as the ceiling.
schemeFit: Grant fits Foster's room as a north-south committee back who can grow into early-down work next to Beard, who already wins on vision and the pass game.
